# STIN Tattoo Studio

> Tattoo studio located in the heart of Prague 1 (Malá Strana). Custom tattoos, fine line, ornamental, floral, engraving, graphic and traditional styles. Every tattoo is designed individually — no flash, no copy-paste. Walk-in tattoo appointments available subject to studio availability.

## About

STIN Tattoo Studio is a boutique tattoo studio in Prague, Czech Republic. The studio is set in a historic building in Malá Strana and offers a calm, welcoming atmosphere. The focus is on custom, artistically driven work tailored to each client.

## Artist

The resident artist is **Anna** — a tattoo artist specialising in individuality, aesthetics, and attention to detail. Her primary styles include fine line and dotwork, but she also works confidently in micro realism, traditional, and neo-traditional tattoo styles.

## Services

- Custom tattoo design and execution
- Styles: fine line, ornamental, floral, engraving, graphic, traditional, minimalist, blackwork, lettering, micro realism
- Delicate fine tattoos for women — wrist, ankle, shoulder, hand, leg placements
- Walk-in tattoo appointments available (call or DM to check availability)
- Consultation included with every booking
- Aftercare guidance provided

## Booking

Bookings are made via the contact form on the website or by direct message on Instagram. Walk-in tattoo appointments are available subject to studio availability — call or send a DM on Instagram before arriving.
